baseline.layerStateSemantics: Every layer is TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN or NOT_APPLICABLE per entity. A count reports TRUE only, always with its denominator; UNKNOWN is shown next to it and is never added to TRUE or FALSE. "0 (structural)" means no code path exists that could make the layer TRUE. UNKNOWN means code exists but the observation needed (a run journal, a probe result, machine state) is not in the repository. No layer is TRUE for an empty input list (no vacuous truth).

layerRules.DEFINED: TRUE iff roleId matches ^UASCO-\d{4}$, occurs exactly once, guildId is in guilds[] and clusterId equals that guild's clusterId; else FALSE (BAD_ROLE_ID / DUPLICATE_ROLE_ID / GUILD_NOT_IN_REGISTRY / CLUSTER_MISMATCH). Never UNKNOWN.

Otherwise FALSE (NO_CANONICAL_SKILLS / SKILL_NOT_IN_SK2 / NO_REQUIRED_TECHNOLOGIES / TECHNOLOGY_NOT_IN_REGISTRY / TECHNOLOGY_STATUS_NOT_PROMOTED). PROPOSED_DERIVED goes to proposedOnly only. In each sourceRef, sourceId, uriOrLocator, effectiveVersion and digestOrRevision are non-empty, fetchedAt is ISO-8601, and sourceClass has allowedForCertification true. Otherwise FALSE (ROLE_KNOWLEDGE_SOURCE_REFS_EMPTY / KNOWLEDGE_PROFILE_MISSING / NO_RESEARCHED_SOURCED_UNIT). Today 0 roles have zero required technologies (minimum 3), so the UNKNOWN branch is guarded by a fixture test and mutant M8.
layerRules.TOOL_READY: No binding: FALSE (ROLE_HAS_NO_BINDING). Adapters empty: FALSE (ADAPTERS_MISSING). No adapterReality map: UNKNOWN (ADAPTER_REALITY_NOT_SUPPLIED). Per adapter: missing entry FALSE (ADAPTER_UNRESOLVED); codePath ABSENT FALSE (ADAPTER_CODE_ABSENT); probe FAILED FALSE (PROBE_FAILED); probe NOT_OBSERVED UNKNOWN (PROBE_NOT_OBSERVED). Any FALSE gives FALSE, else any UNKNOWN gives UNKNOWN, else TRUE. Registry implementation fields are never read.
layerRules.EXECUTABLE: Code path: TRUE iff roleLifecycle().implemented (resolveRoleExecution EXECUTABLE, providerRoute in PRODUCTION_EXECUTOR_ROUTES and function in consumedFunctions()). Otherwise FALSE with the NotExecutableReason, or ROUTE_NOT_PRODUCTION_EXECUTOR and/or STAGE_NOT_CONSUMED (UASCO-0232 gets both). Never UNKNOWN. stageWired is reported separately: no code path FALSE (NO_CODE_PATH); reachableStages absent UNKNOWN (REACHABLE_STAGES_NOT_SUPPLIED); else TRUE iff a consuming stage is in reachableStages, otherwise FALSE (STAGE_NOT_WIRED). backendEnabled is always UNKNOWN.
layerRules.EVALUATED: No specs: FALSE (NO_EVALUATION_SPECS). TRUE iff roleLifecycle().tested (a spec not NOT_EXECUTED with verify()===null; FAKE rejected). Otherwise FALSE (NO_SPEC_EXECUTED / EVIDENCE_REJECTED). CI test runs never feed this layer.
layerRules.INTERNALLY_CERTIFIED: TRUE iff roleLifecycle().certified (6/6 specs PASSED and verified, reviewer APPROVED, scope, not expired). Otherwise FALSE (NOT_CERTIFIED_STATUS / CERTIFICATION_EVIDENCE_INVALID).
layerRules.RUNNING: Journal ABSENT: UNKNOWN (NO_RUN_JOURNAL) for every role, aggregate measured:false, never shown as 0. Journal PRESENT: TRUE iff in runningRoleIdsFromRuns, else FALSE (NOT_IN_OPEN_RUN). Open question, not changed: runningRoleIdsFromRuns treats AWAITING_APPROVAL as open (role-lifecycle.ts:76 vs core/workos/run-state.ts:40).
layerRules.noVacuousTruth: An empty list never yields TRUE: PROFILED needs non-empty skills and technologies; KNOWLEDGE_READY is UNKNOWN with no technologies; TOOL_READY is FALSE with no adapters; EVALUATED is FALSE with no specs; CERTIFIED needs 6/6 specs.
layerRules.anomalies: LAYER_ORDER (EVALUATED without EXECUTABLE, CERTIFIED without EVALUATED, RUNNING without EXECUTABLE) and REGISTRY_CLAIM_EXCEEDS_EVIDENCE (runtimeStatus not UNKNOWN while RUNNING is not TRUE; proficiencyStatus not NOT_EVALUATED while EVALUATED is not TRUE; proficiencyStatus CERTIFIED while CERTIFIED is not TRUE; spec status not NOT_EXECUTED while EVALUATED is not TRUE). Anomalies never change a layer.
layerRules.aggregation: byGuild has a row for every guild in guilds[] (also 0-role guilds); byCluster for every cluster; for every layer and state the group sums equal the totals; denominators are role counts.
